query: textattack adversarial attacks data and in
sql:
SELECT
  p.corpus_id,
  p.title,
  p.abstract,
  p.citation_count,
  p.year
FROM Papers p
WHERE
  (p.title ILIKE '%textattack%' OR p.abstract ILIKE '%textattack%')
  OR (
    (p.title ILIKE '%adversarial%' OR p.abstract ILIKE '%adversarial%')
    AND (p.title ILIKE '%attack%' OR p.abstract ILIKE '%attack%')
  )
  OR (
    (p.title ILIKE '%adversarial attack%' OR p.abstract ILIKE '%adversarial attack%')
  )
ORDER BY
  ts_rank_cd(
    setweight(to_tsvector('english', coalesce(p.title, '')), 'A') ||
    setweight(to_tsvector('english', coalesce(p.abstract, '')), 'B'),
    plainto_tsquery('english', 'textattack adversarial attacks data')
  ) DESC,
  p.citation_count DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 100

query: estimation for translation does really help, m turchi
sql:
SELECT
  p.corpus_id,
  p.title,
  p.abstract,
  p.venue,
  p.canonical_venue,
  p.year,
  p.citation_count
FROM Papers p
LEFT JOIN PaperAuthors pa ON p.corpus_id = pa.corpus_id
LEFT JOIN Authors a ON pa.author_id = a.author_id
WHERE
  (
    (p.title ILIKE '%estimation%' OR p.abstract ILIKE '%estimation%')
    AND
    (p.title ILIKE '%translation%' OR p.abstract ILIKE '%translation%')
  )
  OR
  (
    a.name ILIKE '%turchi%'
    AND (p.title ILIKE '%translation%' OR p.abstract ILIKE '%translation%')
  )
ORDER BY
  CASE
    WHEN a.name ILIKE 'm% turchi%' THEN 0
    WHEN a.name ILIKE '%turchi%' THEN 1
    WHEN p.title ILIKE '%estimation for translation%' THEN 2
    WHEN p.title ILIKE '%estimation%' AND p.title ILIKE '%translation%' THEN 3
    WHEN p.abstract ILIKE '%estimation for translation%' THEN 4
    WHEN p.abstract ILIKE '%estimation%' AND p.abstract ILIKE '%translation%' THEN 5
    ELSE 6
  END,
  p.citation_count DESC
LIMIT 100

   CASE WHEN p.abstract ILIKE '%similarity%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +

SELECT
  p.corpus_id,
  p.title,
  p.abstract,

  p.citation_count DESC

query: a system for fine grained entity in texts, c chu, 2020
sql:
SELECT
  p.corpus_id,
  p.title,
  p.abstract,
  p.year,
  p.citation_count
FROM Papers p
LEFT JOIN PaperAuthors pa ON p.corpus_id = pa.corpus_id
LEFT JOIN Authors a ON pa.author_id = a.author_id
WHERE
  p.year = 2020
  AND (
    (p.title ILIKE '%fine-grained entity%' OR p.title ILIKE '%fine grained entity%' OR p.abstract ILIKE '%fine-grained entity%' OR p.abstract ILIKE '%fine grained entity%')
    OR (p.title ILIKE '%entity recognition%' OR p.abstract ILIKE '%entity recognition%')
  )
  AND (
    a.name ILIKE '%c chu%'
    OR a.name ILIKE 'c.%chu%'
    OR a.name ILIKE 'c %chu%'
  )
ORDER BY
  (CASE WHEN p.title ILIKE '%fine-grained entity%' THEN 3 ELSE 0 END +
   CASE WHEN p.title ILIKE '%fine grained entity%' THEN 3 ELSE 0 END +
   CASE WHEN p.abstract ILIKE '%fine-grained entity%' THEN 2 ELSE 0 END +
   CASE WHEN p.abstract ILIKE '%fine grained entity%' THEN 2 ELSE 0 END +
   CASE WHEN a.name ILIKE '%c chu%' THEN 2 ELSE 0 END +
   CASE WHEN a.name ILIKE 'c.%chu%' THEN 2 ELSE 0 END +
   CASE WHEN a.name ILIKE 'c %chu%' THEN 2 ELSE 0 END +
   CASE WHEN p.year = 2020 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
  ) DESC,
  p.citation_count DESC
LIMIT 100

query: naacl, human paraphrase judgments with deep neural networks, saarland university
sql:
SELECT DISTINCT p.corpus_id,
       p.title,
       p.abstract,
       p.canonical_venue,
       p.venue,
       p.year,
       p.citation_count
FROM Papers p
LEFT JOIN PaperAuthors pa ON p.corpus_id = pa.corpus_id
LEFT JOIN Authors a ON pa.author_id = a.author_id
LEFT JOIN AuthorInstitutions ai ON a.author_id = ai.author_id
LEFT JOIN Institutions i ON ai.institution_id = i.institution_id
WHERE p.canonical_venue ILIKE '%NAACL%'
  AND (
        (p.title ILIKE '%paraphrase%' OR p.abstract ILIKE '%paraphrase%')
    AND (p.title ILIKE '%human%' OR p.abstract ILIKE '%human%')
    AND (
          p.title ILIKE '%deep neural%' OR
          p.abstract ILIKE '%deep neural%' OR
          p.title ILIKE '%neural network%' OR
          p.abstract ILIKE '%neural network%'
        )
      )
  AND (
        i.display_name ILIKE '%saarland%' OR
        i.display_name ILIKE '%saarland university%' OR
        i.display_name ILIKE '%universität des saarlandes%'
      )
ORDER BY
  (CASE WHEN p.title ILIKE '%paraphrase%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
   CASE WHEN p.abstract ILIKE '%paraphrase%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
   CASE WHEN p.title ILIKE '%human%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
   CASE WHEN p.abstract ILIKE '%human%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
   CASE WHEN p.title ILIKE '%deep neural%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
   CASE WHEN p.abstract ILIKE '%deep neural%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
   CASE WHEN p.title ILIKE '%neural network%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
   CASE WHEN p.abstract ILIKE '%neural network%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
   CASE WHEN p.canonical_venue ILIKE '%NAACL%' THEN 2 ELSE 0 END) DESC,
  p.citation_count DESC,
  p.year DESC
LIMIT 100

query: hierarchical model reviews for aspect based sentiment analysis
sql:
SELECT
  p.corpus_id,
  p.title,
  p.abstract,
  p.citation_count,
  p.year
FROM Papers p
WHERE
  (
    (p.title ILIKE '%hierarchical%' OR p.abstract ILIKE '%hierarchical%')
    AND (p.title ILIKE '%aspect%' OR p.abstract ILIKE '%aspect%')
    AND (p.title ILIKE '%sentiment%' OR p.abstract ILIKE '%sentiment%')
  )
  OR (
    (p.title ILIKE '%aspect-based sentiment%' OR p.abstract ILIKE '%aspect-based sentiment%')
    OR (p.title ILIKE '%aspect based sentiment%' OR p.abstract ILIKE '%aspect based sentiment%')
  )
  OR (
    p.title ILIKE '%survey%' OR p.abstract ILIKE '%survey%'
    OR p.title ILIKE '%review%' OR p.abstract ILIKE '%review%'
  )
ORDER BY
  ts_rank_cd(
    setweight(to_tsvector('english', coalesce(p.title, '')), 'A') ||
    setweight(to_tsvector('english', coalesce(p.abstract, '')), 'B'),
    plainto_tsquery('english', 'hierarchical aspect-based sentiment analysis review survey')
  ) DESC,
  p.citation_count DESC NULLS LAST,
  p.year DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 100
